## Verification

- [ ] Tests pass locally and in CI
- [ ] Checked by running it, where tests don't cover the behavior

## Release

- [ ] User-visible change: a line under **Unreleased** in `CHANGELOG.md`, under the heading that sets the bump (**Breaking**, **Added**/**Removed**, or **Changed**/**Fixed**/**Security**)
- [ ] Or not user-visible (CI, tests, internal docs): no changelog line

## Safety

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, internal IPs or customer data in code, docs or history
